strategies.name: US/Iran Peace Deal NO Basket
strategies.description: Stu takes the NO side on all three US/Iran permanent peace deal deadlines (May 31, June 30, December 31) as a single thesis: he believes the market is pricing a 5-37% probability when the true probability is far lower. He explicitly says 'I'd be no on pretty much all of these markets' after walking through each deadline in sequence.
